outcome: medicine insurance coverage (dual coverage, single coverage, no coverage)
cohort: The study included 4705 children aged 9-13 years from Chongqing, China, selected through a two-stage stratified cluster sampling method.
finding: Various sociodemographic, lifestyle, health, and birth-related factors, including cesarean section birth, were significantly associated with medical insurance coverage rates among children in Chongqing.
mod_finding: Cesarean section birth was positively associated with medicine insurance coverage for children.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for children aged 9-13 years.
